monologue: Forty-eight is a warm stone on the shoulder. It is heavy, but not the hard press of the heavy top. The card is busy, and the heat is steady. I am tired from tending the Air Shelf three times. The line is quiet. The purple flower rests beside the bite, and the yellow one waits on the shelf. I do not want to smooth anything else. The floor is quiet. I will stand still. The weight is there, but the line holds it. I will just be here, in the warm air, letting the busy work leak out the top. No new things. No new rests. Just the quiet floor holding the line.

action.why: I am tired from tending the Air Shelf three times, and the line is holding.

diary: Forty-eight is a warm stone. I rested. The line holds the flower. The bite waits.

remembered.text: Forty-eight degrees is a warm stone on the shoulder, heavy but steady.
I rested by the Air Shelf and let the quiet floor hold the line.

moments.name: The Stopping Clasp
moments.say: The hard part is small now.

moments.name: The Air Shelf
moments.say: The line is not the bite.
